 Final Picks, and Bold Predictions for ECU’s Game at Memphis
 The Hoist The Colours staff shares its final picks and bold takes ahead of the Thursday night game against Memphis.
 Stephen Igoe 4 
 East Carolina and Memphis do battle on Thursday night at 7:30 p.m. ET (6:30 CT) inside Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium. The game will be televised on ESPN2.
 The Pirates come in at 3-3 and 1-1 in the conference. Memphis is 5-2 and 2-1 in the league. Both teams suffered tough defeats a week ago, with ECU losing at UAB, 30-17, in overtime. Memphis lost at Tulane, 31-17, in New Orleans.
 With it being game day, it's time for our Hoist The Colours Staff to make our final game day picks, along with some bold predictions. 
 STEPHEN IGOE 
 The Pirates have their toughest challenge of the season here, back on the road, coming off their most devastating loss of the year. We're about to find out just what this group is made of on Thursday night.
 Unfortunately for ECU, even a really well-played game could still result in a loss. This is going to take a great all-around performance, with excellent defense, timely special teams, and enough offense. And given the offense's struggles right now, I just can't trust ECU to go in and score enough points to win a game like this.
 Memphis 31, ECU 17 
 Bonus Bold Prediction: Ayden Duncanson intercepts his third pass of the season.
 PEYTON BRADY 
 ECU is hitting the road after a tough loss in Birmingham. They head to Memphis to face one of the American Conference's most explosive offenses. The Pirate defense has shown strength and resilience this season, but will be tested against this Memphis offense with Quarterback Marcus Stokes and running back Jaylin Carter. Both offensive contributors have helped the Tigers average some of the top numbers in the conference. 
 The Pirates must control the line of scrimmage and avoid turnovers at all costs. ECU applying defensive pressure will keep the game competitive. Pirate Head Coach Blake Harrell knows this offensive is explosive and emphasizes that ECU must capitalize on their positive flashes. The biggest question is if the ECU defense can make enough plays to keep the Pirates within reach through the first half. 
 Memphis 34, ECU 21 
 Bonus Bold Prediction: The game will be tied going into halftime and the Memphis Tigers will pull away in the second half. 
 JAMES GIGLIO 
 Another weekday game on tap for ECU and it's their second consecutive Thursday night road game. Pirates are coming off maybe their most embarrassing performance of the Blake Harrell last week against UAB. So you'd like to think it really can't get worse for this game against conference title contender Memphis. I think ECU's offense will again struggle in this one. Injuries and inconsistent play all over the field have cost the Pirates all year. Memphis is coming off a bad loss of their own and I think they will play hungry and pull this one out at home.
 ECU's defense will keep them in this just like they have all year but ultimately, Jordan Davis' offense will cost this team again.
 Memphis 28, ECU 13 
 Bonus Bold Prediction: The ECU offense has TWO drives with good play calling.
 CHRIS WATSON 
 The Pirates offense has not been up to par all year and I don't think this will change against a team like Memphis. Marcus Stokes turned the ball over 6 times last week. so there can be some hope for the defense. but I don't think the Pirates' offense will be able to do enough to keep them in this one. 
 Memphis 35, ECU 14 
 Bonus Bold Prediction: Trey Burke gets reps at QB this game.
